test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Why are civil disobedience movements mentioned in the passage?

options.text: To show moral challenges to unjust laws

solution: The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. To show moral challenges to unjust laws**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage mentions **civil disobedience movements** to illustrate how people have challenged laws they believed to be unjust, guided by moral principles. (अन्यायपूर्ण कानूनों को नैतिक चुनौती दिखाने के लिए) • **Example:** The Civil Rights Movement in the USA involved breaking certain laws to protest racial injustice, aiming for legal reform. • Such movements show that morality and legality can conflict, and that moral action has sometimes been necessary to change or reform unfair laws. • This highlights the complex and evolving relationship between moral values and legal rules. Therefore, the correct answer is- To show moral challenges to unjust laws [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To promote lawlessness** (अराजकता को बढ़ावा देने के लिए): Means encouraging people to ignore or break the law without reason. • **Example:** The passage does not support breaking the law for its own sake, but rather for moral reform. • **To justify criminal acts** (आपराधिक कृत्यों को उचित ठहराने के लिए): Means providing reasons for illegal activities. • **Example:** The passage describes principled, morally motivated protest, not criminal justification. • **To criticise legal systems entirely** (कानूनी प्रणालियों की पूरी तरह आलोचना करने के लिए): Means rejecting all legal systems. • **Example:** The passage acknowledges the role of law but also its limitations; it does not condemn all legal systems. 3f:Tc2c, The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Ethical concerns before laws adapt**.
